description: build_jmap_dispatcher has a hardcoded &[&str] list of 31 method names. If a developer adds a new arm to route_method's match but forgets to add the method to METHODS, the Dispatcher returns unknownMethod instead of dispatching it — a silent behavioral divergence with no compile-time check. Add a comment co-locating the METHODS list with the match arms, or derive the list from the match (e.g. via a const array used in both places).
title: METHODS array in build_jmap_dispatcher can silently go stale vs route_method arms
